record.paper_title: Open Problems in Quantum Information Theory
record.original_question: Let A be a positive semidefinite block matrix on a d1 d2-dimensional space, written as d2 × d2 blocks A_jk of size d1 × d1, with Σ_j A_jj = M. Can one always find d2 block vectors X_m, each composed of d2 blocks X_jm of size d1 × d1, such that A = (1/d2) Σ_{m=1}^{d2} X_m X_m† and, for every m, Σ_k X_km X_km† = M?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 5. Let A be a d1d2 positive semi-definite matrix consisting of d2 × d2 blocks Ajk each of size d1 × d1, with Σj Ajj = M. Then one can find d2 vectors Xm composed of d2 blocks Xjm of size d1 × d1 such that A = Σ d2 m=1 1/d2 XmX†m, and Σk XkmX†km = M ∀ m.
Conjecture 5 is clearly a generalization of Horn’s lemma to block matrices.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d_1, d_2$ be positive integers and let $A$ be a positive semidefinite matrix acting on $\mathbb{C}^{d_1}\otimes \mathbb{C}^{d_2}$. Write $A$ as a $d_2\times d_2$ array of blocks $A_{jk}\in M_{d_1}(\mathbb{C})$ (so $A_{kj}=A_{jk}^\dagger$ and $A=(A_{jk})_{j,k=1}^{d_2}$ is positive semidefinite as an operator on $\mathbb{C}^{d_1 d_2}$), and set
$$M:=\sum_{j=1}^{d_2} A_{jj}\in M_{d_1}(\mathbb{C}).$$
Prove or disprove: there always exist $d_2$ "block vectors" $X_m$ ($m=1,\dots,d_2$), each consisting of $d_2$ blocks $X_{jm}\in M_{d_1}(\mathbb{C})$ stacked vertically (so $X_m$ is a $d_1 d_2 \times d_1$ matrix with blocks $X_{1m},\dots,X_{d_2 m}$), such that
$$A \;=\; \frac{1}{d_2}\sum_{m=1}^{d_2} X_m X_m^\dagger,$$
and, for every $m\in\{1,\dots,d_2\}$,
$$\sum_{k=1}^{d_2} X_{km} X_{km}^\dagger \;=\; M.$$
(When $d_1=1$ this reduces to the classical Horn lemma stating that any positive semidefinite matrix can be written as an average of rank-one matrices having equal diagonals.)
artifact.category_tag: Block matrix decompositions in quantum information
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches for this specific block-matrix generalization of Horn's lemma did not yield a definitive resolution. While there is substantial related literature on positive semidefinite block matrix decompositions and quantum analogues of Horn's conjecture, no source directly confirming a proof or disproof of this particular conjecture was found.

status_evidence.title: Quantum Generalization of the Horn Conjecture (AMS)
status_evidence.snippet: Proves a quantum multiplicative analogue of the Horn conjecture and saturation conjecture, but addresses a different problem than the block-vector decomposition stated here.
status_evidence.claim: Related quantum Horn-type results exist but do not directly resolve this conjecture.

status_evidence.title: On a decomposition lemma for positive semi-definite block-matrices
status_evidence.snippet: Decomposition lemmas for PSD block matrices with Hermitian blocks, related to the partial-trace average.
status_evidence.claim: Related decomposition lemmas exist for PSD block matrices but are distinct from the stated equal-diagonal block decomposition.
